histories.prompt: POV handheld shot from a small aluminum rescue boat now close alongside a wooden fence post in muddy floodwater. Two frightened squirrels are huddled together on top of the post, tails raised nervously as the boat pulls up beside them. A human hand and forearm, wearing a dark rain jacket sleeve, slowly reaches out from the boat toward the squirrels, palm open, calm and reassuring, not yet touching them. Overcast daylight, trees partially submerged in background, water droplets on the boat rail. Cinematic realistic documentary wildlife rescue style, natural handheld camera motion.
